question: You investigate the standard behavior of the two sales document types Delivery Free of Charge (FD) and Subsequent Delivery Free of Charge (SD). What do you find out? (Choose two.) A. Documents of both document types can use the same item category. B. A Delivery Free of Charge is used to deliver material due to a complaint. C. A Subsequent Delivery Free of Charge has to be created with reference to a preceding document. D. In both cases, materials are priced and billed normally but the shipping is free of charge.
discussion: Selected Answer: AC A. Documents of both document types can use the same item category: In standard SAP configuration, both the Delivery Free of Charge (FD) and the Subsequent Delivery Free of Charge (SD) can use the same item category if the configuration supports it. The item category is determined by factors such as the item category group in the material master and the sales order settings. C. A Subsequent Delivery Free of Charge has to be created with reference to a preceding document: By design, the Subsequent Delivery Free of Charge (SD) is created with reference to an earlier sales order or delivery document. This ensures that it is linked to the original transaction and reflects that it is a follow-on delivery free of charge. Options B and D do not reflect standard behavior. upvoted 1 time Submit Cancel

question: How can you reduce the maintenance effort for the customer master data? (Choose two.) A. Use customer-vendor integration. B. Use multi-address handling. C. Use business partner roles. D. Use the common master data concept.
discussion: Selected Answer: CD C. Use business partner roles: In SAP S/4HANA, the customer master data is maintained within the Business Partner (BP) framework. By using BP roles (for example, customer, vendor, etc.), you can assign multiple roles to a single business partner. This consolidation reduces redundant data maintenance and simplifies master data management. D. Use the common master data concept: SAP S/4HANA follows a common master data concept, which centralizes and consolidates data for different areas (such as customers and vendors) into a single, unified record. question: How is the link between SAP S/4HANA Sales and SAP S/4HANA Finance set up? A. Via the link between a billing document request and an accounting document B. Via the copying control between the invoice and the accounting document C. Via the general billing interface available in the system D. Via a unique assignment of a sales organization to a company code
discussion: Selected Answer: D Copying control is a mechanism in SAP SD that governs how data is transferred between different documents (for example, from a sales order to a billing document, or from a delivery to a billing document). However, copying control does not serve as the integration link between SAP S/4HANA Sales and Finance. The connection between Sales and Finance is established structurally through the assignment of a sales organization to a company code. This organizational linkage ensures that billing documents generated in Sales are posted to the correct financial entity in Finance. Thus, while copying control plays a critical role in the document flow within Sales, it is not the mechanism used to interface with Finance. upvoted 1 time Submit Cancel
